687-2034-3862-4613-8130.description:
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Orcish Bowmasters from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-3862-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Vizier of Tumbling Sands or North Pole Patrol

1719-7014-7786.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1430-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1430-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1430-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4785-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4785-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

2105-5231-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5231-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-5078-5202-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Efficient Construction and Forensic Gadgeteer trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat.

872-1323-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Scaled Herbalist each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
872-1323-4543.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Scaled Herbalist's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.

112-3152-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
112-3152-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Chakram Retriever.
Chakram Retriever triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target another creature with Clockspinning to get infinite proliferate, or you may use Chakram Retriever's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

427-2054-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-2054-3525.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1263-2060-3602-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

230-2252-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-4050-4871.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {1}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2778-4112.description:
Cast Wall of Stolen Identity by paying {3}{U}.
Wall of Stolen Identity enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Wall of Stolen Identity triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

2178-2817-4050-4149.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
1 other creature on the battlefield.
2178-2817-4050-4149.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.

2684-2724-4168.notablePrerequisites: Civic Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2684-2724-4168.description:
Tap Civic Guildmage for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Activate Mastery of the Unseen for {3}{W} to manifest Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.

186-1409-4617-4720.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Soulbright Flamekin.
186-1409-4617-4720.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times paying {1} each time, adding eight {R} with the third activation.
Activate Stonework Packbeast for {1} to add {U}.
Pay {U} to activate the ability granted to Soulbright Flamekin by Deadeye Navigator, blinking it.
When it ETBs, pair it with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat this process for infinite mana.
If you have another creature with an ETB, you can flicker Deadeye and pair it to that creature, then flicker that creature infinite times.

2103-5021-5261.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

250-779-2891.description:
Activate Olivia's Dragoon by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Olivia's Dragoon ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

45-1987-2427-2556.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
